policy: The agent owns this slate. A topic is researched from its listed free sources, then authored and validated by the authoring pass: a ledger of verbatim sentences, narration whose every number occurs in its supporting row, and an argument map with at least five sources. A topic that fails the ledger audit stays research; nothing is rendered from an unverified storyboard.
